LanguageData.RT_M113M_APC.label: M113(M) Mortar Carrier
LanguageData.RT_M113M_APC.description:
Self-propelled mortar carrier armed with a 120mm M121 mortar for indirect artillery support and a .50 BMG defense MG.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander/Gunner x1, Mortar Crew x4 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 120mm M121 Mortar: 120mm Mortar shell (HE / EMP / Smoke) - .50 Cal M2 Browning: .50 BMG cartridge (FMJ / AP / Incendiary / Sabot)
